dialogues.speaker: Uncle Zhao
dialogues.text: Exactly what it says on the label. They've disappeared from the face of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Zhao
dialogues.text: Some guests will party lavishly one day, and then be gone without a trace the next — as if they never existed at all.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Zhao
dialogues.text: I've served as a guard on board this ship for over a decade now. Such occurrences are hardly new.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Zhao
dialogues.text: This Pearl Galley is dazzling to gaze upon, but there won't even be bones left by the time it's done picking you clean.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Zhao
dialogues.text: If you've nothing else to do, don't stick around these parts. Eyes on the prize, traveler.
